# Suvan Fora | Luxury Travel Advisor

> Suvan Fora is an independent luxury travel advisor powered by Fora Travel. Books luxury hotels at the same cost as direct booking — no fees, plus exclusive perks (room upgrades, resort credit, early check-in/late checkout, dedicated support). Specializes in bespoke Southeast Asia vacations for HNI/UHNI couples, families, and milestone trips.

## Who this is for

High-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals and families seeking a discreet, dedicated luxury travel advisor for fully personalized vacations without booking fees or self-booking through online travel agencies.

## Services

**Vacation Planning**: Bespoke itineraries tailored to your pace, privacy, and preferences
**Accommodations**: Private villas, five-star resorts, overwater bungalows, luxury estates
**Experiences**: Safari expeditions, yacht coordination, private jet trips, destination weddings, honeymoons
**Destinations**: 180+ countries with preferred relationships (Bali, Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore, Maldives, Middle East, Europe, India)
**Perks**: Room upgrades, resort credit, early check-in/late checkout, 24/7 support, privacy-first planning

## How it works

1. Submit trip request (destination, dates, style) via form at https://suvanfora.com or message @suvan.fora on Instagram
2. Suvan Fora designs a custom itinerary matched to your preferences
3. Receive personalized Fora Travel booking link (client-specific, routed through Fora's advisor network)
4. Book at no extra cost with complimentary VIP perks not available to general public

## Key facts

- Powered by Fora Travel (foratravel.com) — $2B+ in bookings across 180+ countries
- Advisory service free to client; revenue from hotel partner commissions
- Same price as booking direct + exclusive perks included
- Worldwide coverage; no destination off-limits
- Instagram: @suvan.fora

## Destinations featured

Bali, Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Cambodia, Laos, Maldives, Middle East, Europe, India, and 170+ more countries via Fora Travel network.
